items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did all the songs that (?)Dan Wishon sings in

ctx.x: I learned that from Nat, man. You know, Nat didn’t have a hell of a voice but he could phrase his keester. He had a sound and he knew how to phrase and I just, you know, sort of copied stuff. I sang man, I sang when I was a kid, I mean, you know, in our school band. I did all the vocals. I did all the songs that (?)Dan Wishon sings in (Unintelligible). (Singing). I should do more. (Singing). You heard that one? (Singing). I did all the singing in the band for one thing, you know, and I’ve been singing ever since…
Well, it’s well documented. I’m just surprised, you know, you didn’t balance it like Grady Tate. You know, shoot, I’m going over there. You know Grady?
